messages:
Maya (PM): Need final scope for Private packaging next sprint. Core asks: installer artifact, upgrade handoff for customer-managed networks, and rollback guarantees. Owners?
Leo (SRE): Recommend 'handshake-first' approach — customer confirms upgrade window. Full orchestration later. Keeps risk low.
Tariq (Field): Customers want IP pinning and the ability to decline automatic upgrades. Also expect a clear rollback timeline.
Hannah (NetEng): For IP pinning we can support static-route + BGP preserving. Cloud instances may still get new host IPs — we should call that out.
Maya (PM): Decision attempt: ship handshake handoff + snapshot-based rollback in MVP. OK?
Sam (Docs): I'll create a one-page "Upgrade Handoff" guide and a short rollback runbook.
ops-bot: ops-bot: CI 2024.11.3 — integration tests passed :white_check_mark:
Leo (SRE): Upgrade flow proposal: manifest verify -> preflight checks -> create KV snapshot -> pause autoscale -> execute upgrade -> postchecks -> on fail, restore snapshot + revert manifest.
Tariq (Field): Pilot candidates: NebulaHealth, ByteWorks, HarborBank. I'll coordinate windows and acceptance criteria.
Hannah (NetEng): Handshake protocol: customer posts token and target window to `/handshake` endpoint; system validates ASN/CIDR, returns approved TTL. We'll include explicit 'preserve_ips' flag.
Maya (PM): Manifest additions: "upgrade.handoff.mode", "upgrade.handoff.token", "network.ip_pinning": "true|false". Keep backwards compat.
Leo (SRE): CLI example: `rw-upgrade --manifest m.json --handshake-token xyz --preserve-ips`.
Sam (Docs): Draft due 2026-04-08, Eng impl by 2026-04-15, Field pilots start 2026-04-20. Is that realistic?
Hannah (NetEng): Legal needs to approve IP retention clause. I'll open a legal request and tag security.
Tariq (Field): Also want a customer-facing opt-out checkbox in console and a short FAQ.
Maya (PM): Great. Freeze if no objections by EOD Thursday. Weekly check-ins until pilots finish. Thanks.
